entities.summary: Bonifazio Veronese, born Bonifazio de' Pitati, was a Venetian Renaissance painter who was active in the Venetian Republic. His work had an important influence on the younger generation of painters in Venice, particularly Andrea Schiavone and Jacopo Tintoretto.
